seed: Assume some mechanic is not a function of the visible state, for example a turn order, a patrol route or a hidden counter. Carry hidden state across calls, gated on continuity.

synth.notes:
Mirror-axis game: 21x21 board of 3x3 blocks, axis band colour 10 on one block row, targets 11, pieces 5-rings, reflections 4.
A1/A2 move selection (axis or piece) one block row; A3/A4 move a piece a column; pieces blocked by board edge and other pieces, not by the axis.
A5 cycles axis -> pieces by size desc -> axis; each off-axis piece block reflects to row 2A-r unless a piece covers it.
HUD col 63 counts effective actions (12s from top; past 64, 5s overwrite from top). Parsed statelessly from the frame each call.
Hidden turn order/patrol hypothesis not needed: the only accumulated state (HUD counter) is visible in the frame. n>=128 unconfirmed.
